lines.text: This is a short example made with rv.
Everything you see is drawn from a few lines of code.
In the middle there is a steel plate, resting on a bench.
Next to it hangs a thin probe, waiting above the surface.
The camera stays still while words appear.
Now watch the probe come down.
Now the probe touches the plate.
The camera moved in with it. This is an action shot.
It starts after the transition and lasts about two seconds.
A label names the part while it is in view.
From a lower angle, we see the whole plate again.
The probe slides slowly from left to right.
Only the probe moves, so the eye knows where to look.
Each scene is a function of time, so any frame can be drawn again.
That is the whole example. Change a line, and run it again.
